question: What is the meaning of safety data sheet in relation to safety information?
description: A Safety Data Sheet (SDS) is a document that provides information on the health and safety aspects of a product, including its composition, hazards, safe handling practices, and emergency measures. It is used globally to ensure safe use and handling of chemicals and materials. The SDS is a crucial part of the safety information provided to users and handlers of a product.
